stations.title: Kasimir
stations.note: He thinks of parts by name.

stations.title: Drawer slips
stations.text: A slip per drawer, found by hunting for it.

captions: Kasimir puts three more crowns in a drawer and wants the stock to follow.
The counts are on slips, one per drawer, and finding the right slip takes a hunt.
You keep the stock in a map, under each part's name, and look up without adding.
Now the crowns go up by three, a question adds no drawer, and the stock reads in order.
Parts are found by name now. Next, Ambrose wants the month's bills sorted and summed.
